summary: Round r1 (restricted network). Q1 (Nepal's current FATF/APG status and remaining action items) is pending: status must be established from a dated primary statement, and none has been retrieved. The most recent dated FATF plenary statement located is 'Jurisdictions under Increased Monitoring - 19 June 2026'; the February 2026 and 21 February 2025 statements, the FATF Nepal country page, the black-and-grey-lists page, the 2023 APG Mutual Evaluation Report and the 2025 APG follow-up report were also located, plus the IMF 2026 staff report and NRB FSR Issue 17 for reform-progress context. Any later FATF plenary (after June 2026) must be checked at retrieval. Action-plan themes surfaced by search are recorded only as unverified items to be replaced by verbatim text.

findings.claim: Exit from increased monitoring normally requires completing or largely completing all action-plan items, followed by an FATF on-site visit and a plenary decision; timing is therefore not predictable and no exit date or probability is assigned.
findings.note: Procedural description to be verified from the FATF black-and-grey-lists page.

data_gaps: APG website (apgml.org) Nepal pages and APG annual-meeting outcomes for 2025-2026 not located as direct leads (search budget exhausted).
No located document gives a timetable for Nepal's action-plan deadlines; FATF statements often reference deadlines that must be read from the text.
Whether any FATF plenary after 19 June 2026 has occurred and changed Nepal's status must be checked on retrieval of the FATF index page.
The session web-search budget was exhausted before all planned searches ran; some leads below were reused from 16A/16B and some document-level leads remain unlocated (listed individually).
No lead URL was downloaded in r1 (data hosts blocked); all values await `python -m src.cli leads --fetch`, extraction and ingest in r2.

assumptions.text: Listing status is taken only from the latest dated FATF plenary statement at retrieval time; news reports, the NRB or government statements are secondary and used only to locate the statement.
No probability or date of exit from increased monitoring is assigned; scenario S10 treats continued listing and de-listing as alternative stress settings.

challenges.text: EXP-18 should be updated from the latest dated FATF statement at retrieval, not from the February 2025 statement alone; lead L65 in 16B should be supplemented with the February 2026 and June 2026 statements.
Supply of dated listing events: February 2025 (listing, to be verified) and June 2026 (latest located statement); de-risking tests should use these dates.
Red-team item: a change in Nepal's FATF status at a plenary after June 2026 would alter S03/S10 correspondent-banking and remittance-channel assumptions; re-check before audit.

uncertainty: High on current status timing: FATF status can change at each plenary; the last located statement is from June 2026 and a later plenary outcome, if any, is not captured. Action-item texts are unverified until retrieved verbatim. MER ratings are fixed at the 2023 assessment date except where re-rated by follow-up reports.
